criteria: project-board.html is one self-contained SPA (hash routing + localStorage): dashboard, projects and tasks CRUD, a kanban board (Todo/In Progress/Review/Done), search and filters, form validation, toasts, JSON export/import, and seeded demo data. No frameworks or external libraries.

review.description: Single-file SaaS-style SPA: hash routing, localStorage, projects/tasks CRUD, kanban board, search/filters, validation, toasts, JSON export/import, demo data.
